hardware_prior.evidence_class: vendor-reported/shared-inventory prior, not measured for this component

decompositions.description: One BF16 M384xK by KxV output-head GEMM, FP32 conversion, FP32 softcap, row argmax, tree verify, then request/KV commit.
decompositions.greedy_interface_accounting: BF16 GEMM store + cast BF16 read/FP32 write + softcap FP32 read/write + argmax FP32 read
decompositions.claim_limit: Operation boundaries and logical bytes are source-backed/analytical. Actual launch count, caching, latency, and traffic are unmeasured.

decompositions.description: Process one 32-row request slab at a time with the stock full-vocabulary GEMM and exact stock processors, sampler, and acceptance.
decompositions.falsifier_result: It bounds workspace but rereads the 2.625-GiB tied head twelve times and adds eleven GEMM launches. Its ideal excess weight-read time is over 15x the fused candidate's entire removable-interface time scale.

decompositions.description: A CUTLASS/CuTe-style BF16 GEMM with BM64xBN256 output tiles rounds each accumulator to BF16, converts to FP32, applies stock softcap and tile-local processors, and stores only per-row (value, lowest_vocab_id) partials. One request-owned reducer consumes 12x1024 partials, performs exact lowest-ID argmax plus VerifyTreeGreedy, and hands predicts/accept_indices to unchanged fill/finish/KV commit.
source_visible_precommit_operations: fused BF16 lm_head GEMM plus partial argmax
request-owned partial reduction plus tree greedy acceptance
resource_risks: BM64xBN256 epilogue row reduction may raise registers or shared memory enough to reduce GEMM throughput.
Stock BF16 GEMM arithmetic and BF16 output rounding must be reproduced before softcap; FP32-accumulator argmax is semantically invalid.
FP32 softcap saturation can create ties, so reducing raw accumulator maxima is semantically invalid.
The 3-MiB partial buffer and second-stage reduction may erase the interface gain.
CUTLASS dispatch and CUDA graph integration are unproved until target execution.
decompositions.evidence_class: analytical schedule plus measured deterministic CPU semantics; performance unmeasured

sampled_branch_negative.reason: Exact top-p requires global probability ordering/cumulative mass; arbitrary custom processors may inspect or rewrite a whole row; output top-logprobs can request an unbounded ordered set. A bounded constant-state streaming reducer cannot preserve those interfaces for all inputs.
sampled_branch_negative.disposition: Fail closed to the pinned materialized path. This negative does not apply to the qualified temperature-zero branch.

whole_request_relevance.interpretation: Derived by delta_per_full_wave * request_wave_exposures / (32 requests * 32 rows-per-full-wave). It is only a byte-time scale under peak HBM with zero cache reuse, not a measured latency prediction or strict endpoint bound.

decision.next_fidelity: One exact H200 producer-to-acceptance component discriminator, only after separate spend and claim authority.
